requirements.title: Variable and common-block binding labels name entities to the companion processor
requirements.source: S18.9.2 p1; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF545.
requirements.definition: The binding label of a variable or common block is a default character value specifying the name by which the variable or common block is known to the companion processor.

pending.variable-common-binding-label-companion-: Mixed C plan binds a Fortran module variable to C global label c_label_value, initializes the C object to 167, and observes Fortran reading 167 through the binding label.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Mixed Fortran/C plans use the suite C interop harness with separate C and Fortran sources. They guard every ISO_C_BINDING kind constant with k > 0 before using it as a kind and observe only portable properties fixed by Clause 18: exact integer or exactly representable real sentinel values, successful linkage through required binding labels, Fortran ALLOCATED or ASSOCIATED status after CFI calls, and required diagnostics for numbered constraints. Program obligations on C descriptors, object lifetimes, setjmp/longjmp, signal handling, floating-point status, and asynchronous communication are not treated as required diagnostics unless a numbered constraint owns the rejection.

requirements.title: NAME= gives a nonblank trimmed binding label for variables and common blocks
requirements.source: S18.9.2 p2.name-specifier-trimmed-nonzero-label; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF545.
requirements.definition: For a variable or common block with BIND and a NAME= expression whose value has nonzero length after discarding leading and trailing blanks, that trimmed value is the binding label.

pending.variable-common-name-specifier-trimmed-l: Mixed C plan defines global int MyVariable = 173; After guarding C_INT > 0 before any C_INT-kind declaration, Fortran declares integer(c_int), bind(C, name="  MyVariable  ") :: f and verifies reading 173, proving leading and trailing blanks are not part of the label.

requirements.title: Variable and common-block binding labels preserve case significance
requirements.source: S18.9.2 p2.binding-label-case-significant; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF545.
requirements.definition: The case of letters in a variable or common-block binding label is significant.

requirements.title: BIND variables or common blocks without NAME= use the lower-case Fortran entity name as label
requirements.source: S18.9.2 p2.default-lowercase-entity-name-label; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF545.
requirements.definition: For a variable or common block with BIND specified without NAME=, the binding label is the entity name converted to lower case letters.

pending.variable-common-default-binding-label-lo: Mixed C plan defines global int mixed_name = 191; After guarding C_INT > 0 before any C_INT-kind declaration, Fortran declares integer(c_int), bind(C) :: MIXED_NAME and verifies the value 191 through the default lower-case binding label mixed_name.

requirements.title: Variables and common blocks outside the BIND label cases have no binding label
requirements.source: S18.9.2 p2.no-label-otherwise; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF545.
requirements.definition: A variable or common block has no binding label outside the nonblank NAME= and BIND-without-NAME= cases.

requirements.title: Matching Fortran and C variable labels establish linkage association
requirements.source: S18.9.2 p3; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF545.
requirements.definition: A C external-linkage variable has the C variable name as its binding label, and a Fortran BIND variable or common block with the same binding label is linkage associated with it.

pending.c-variable-binding-label-is-c-name: Mixed C plan defines C global int c_named = 193; Fortran binds a module variable with NAME="c_named" and observes value 193, deriving the C binding label from the C name.
pending.matching-variable-common-labels-create-l: Mixed C plan writes 197 through Fortran to a BIND(C, NAME="shared_label") module variable and calls a C helper that reads C global shared_label as 197, proving linkage association by the matching label.

NAME=, case significance, default lower-case labels, and no-label fallback are split.
Defines absence of a binding label outside the specified BIND cases.

review_rationale: Source registration for 18.6-18.10.4: restrictions on C descriptors and lifetimes, interoperation with C global variables and binding labels, and interoperation with C functions (batch245). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; cross-language calls, descriptors and binding labels are planned as mixed Fortran/C programs with exact results, and program-side restrictions carry no oracle. C1807 had no existing tests. Source accounting only.
